note: Activity Bar -- platform's own interface with fixed view icons (Explorer, Search, Source Control, Run and Debug, Extensions, Accounts, Settings)

Status Bar -- platform's own interface and computed status values (host, problems, forwarded ports, notifications, editor mode, language status, eol, encoding, indentation, selection, screen reader mode)
Editor tab actions toolbar -- platform controls for splitting editor and more tab actions
Notification toast controls -- platform controls for notification actions (clear, configure, dismiss)
